evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: We have talked to a lot of customers everyday so 11 of them or two. Do you always raised one or two concerns? So either they are worried about movers not showing up on time or damage items or either of those a concern for you by any chance?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Oh, okay. So, so I can hear, we're more concerned about the damage of the items. Is that right? [Casie confirms yes, but rep does not continue probing with 'tell me more' or silence.]
evidence_quotes.value_days: And upon checking here on Thursday the twenty second and the twenty third we still have availability as early as 8:30 AM to 9:00 AM we can be able to book your spot
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: there's no deposit required, no risk and securing your spot in case if you wanted to reschedule or to cancel then all you have to do is just simply give us a call at anytime. Would you like me to lock that in for you?

top_strength: Rep delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) with full terms and dollar figures clearly stated, building strong credibility early in the call.
coaching_note: After the customer names damage as a concern, dig deeper with 'tell me more about that' and silence instead of moving directly to the promises — two layers, not one, is what step 2 requires.
